title: Synthetic Survey Data Generation and Evaluation
summary: A research repository comparing several synthetic tabular data generators (Synthpop, CTGAN, TVAE, REaDTabFormer, SMOTE) on voter/demographic survey data, evaluated with the SynthEval utility and privacy metrics. It runs SDV's TVAESynthesizer (via sdv.single_table and sdv.metadata) and the standalone ctgan package as two of the generation methods under comparison.
